52:         assert!(self.rdr.buffer()[self.core.pos()..].is_empty());

55:         let old_buf_len = self.rdr.buffer().len();

143:     pub fn new(
144:         searcher: &'s Searcher,
145:         matcher: M,
146:         slice: &'s [u8],

153:             core: Core::new(searcher, matcher, write_to, true),
154:             slice: slice,
155:             last_match: None,
156:         }
157:     }

159:     pub fn run(mut self) -> Result<(), S::Error> {
160:         if self.core.begin()? {
161:             let binary_upto =
162:                 cmp::min(self.slice.len(), DEFAULT_BUFFER_CAPACITY);
163:             let binary_range = Range::new(0, binary_upto);
164:             if !self.core.detect_binary(self.slice, &binary_range)? {
165:                 let mut keepgoing = true;
166:                 while !self.slice[self.core.pos()..].is_empty() && keepgoing {
167:                     keepgoing = self.sink()?;
168:                 }
169:                 if keepgoing {
170:                     keepgoing = match self.last_match.take() {
171:                         None => true,
172:                         Some(last_match) => {
173:                             if self.sink_context(&last_match)? {
174:                                 self.sink_matched(&last_match)?;
175:                             }
176:                             true
177:                         }
178:                     };
179:                 }
180:                 // Take care of any remaining context after the last match.
181:                 if keepgoing {
182:                     if self.config.passthru {
183:                         self.core.other_context_by_line(

185:                             self.slice.len(),

202:         if self.config.invert_match {
203:             return self.sink_matched_inverted();

206:             Some(range) => range,
207:             None => {

215:             lines::locate(self.slice, self.config.line_term.as_byte(), mat);

220:         match self.last_match.take() {

231:                 // Note that we do not technically require strict overlap here.
232:                 // Instead, we only require that the lines are adjacent. This
233:                 // provides larger blocks of lines to the printer, and results
234:                 // in overall better behavior with respect to how replacements
235:                 // are handled.
236:                 //
237:                 // See: https://github.com/BurntSushi/ripgrep/issues/1311
238:                 // And also the associated commit fixing #1311.
239:                 if last_match.end() >= line.start() {
240:                     self.last_match = Some(last_match.with_end(line.end()));
241:                     Ok(true)
242:                 } else {
243:                     self.last_match = Some(line);
244:                     if !self.sink_context(&last_match)? {
245:                         return Ok(false);
246:                     }
247:                     self.sink_matched(&last_match)
248:                 }
249:             }
250:         }
251:     }

253:     fn sink_matched_inverted(&mut self) -> Result<bool, S::Error> {
254:         assert!(self.config.invert_match);
255: 
256:         let invert_match = match self.find()? {
257:             None => {
258:                 let range = Range::new(self.core.pos(), self.slice.len());
259:                 self.core.set_pos(range.end());
260:                 range
261:             }
262:             Some(mat) => {
263:                 let line = lines::locate(
264:                     self.slice,
265:                     self.config.line_term.as_byte(),
266:                     mat,
267:                 );
268:                 let range = Range::new(self.core.pos(), line.start());
269:                 self.advance(&line);
270:                 range
271:             }
272:         };
273:         if invert_match.is_empty() {
274:             return Ok(true);
275:         }
276:         if !self.sink_context(&invert_match)? {
277:             return Ok(false);
278:         }
279:         let mut stepper = LineStep::new(
280:             self.config.line_term.as_byte(),
281:             invert_match.start(),
282:             invert_match.end(),
283:         );
284:         while let Some(line) = stepper.next_match(self.slice) {
285:             if !self.sink_matched(&line)? {
286:                 return Ok(false);
287:             }
288:         }

292:     fn sink_matched(&mut self, range: &Range) -> Result<bool, S::Error> {
293:         if range.is_empty() {
294:             // The only way we can produce an empty line for a match is if we
295:             // match the position immediately following the last byte that we
296:             // search, and where that last byte is also the line terminator. We
297:             // never want to report that match, and we know we're done at that
298:             // point anyway, so stop the search.
299:             return Ok(false);
300:         }
301:         self.core.matched(self.slice, range)

304:     fn sink_context(&mut self, range: &Range) -> Result<bool, S::Error> {

309:         } else {
